queries.label: Contagem e ausência de sinopses
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS works, SUM(word_count=0) AS missing_synopsis FROM works;

queries.label: Gêneros mais frequentes
queries.sql: SELECT genre,COUNT(*) AS works FROM genres GROUP BY genre ORDER BY works DESC LIMIT 12;

queries.label: Exemplo de busca com gênero
queries.sql: SELECT w.anilist_id,w.title,w.word_count FROM works w JOIN genres g USING(anilist_id) WHERE g.genre='Action' AND w.title LIKE '%Lycoris%' ORDER BY w.title;

queries.label: Integridade dos vetores
queries.sql: SELECT model,dimensions,COUNT(*) AS vectors FROM vectors GROUP BY model,dimensions;

queries.label: Cobertura comunitária
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(average_score) AS weighted_scores,COUNT(mean_score) AS mean_scores,COUNT(popularity) AS popularity,COUNT(community_favourites) AS favourites FROM works;

queries.label: Chaves órfãs
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_genres FROM genres g LEFT JOIN works w USING(anilist_id) WHERE w.anilist_id IS NULL;
